factor_diagnostics.note: Descriptive statistics of the frozen TEST panels the models were given, from the M0R datasets. IC is the per-signal-date cross-sectional Spearman correlation with raw_return_5d, averaged over dates; ic_ir_daily is mean/std across dates (NOT annualised); ic_t_stat assumes independent days, which overlapping 5-day labels violate, so it is an upper bound on significance. top50_spread is the mean over dates of (mean return of that date's top-50 by factor value - that date's cross-sectional mean), in percentage points. This is NOT a retraining result: a factor with low standalone IC can still contribute inside a nonlinear model, and a negative IC simply means the useful direction is short the factor.

tail_shape.note: top3_share is the fraction of the day's basket total return produced by its three best names; it is only interpretable on days the basket made money, so the mean is reported alongside the share of negative days.
